purpose: Review of P-0003 (two species-A particles at rest, K/r^2.5 attraction for separations 3 to 6): separation 4.0 along x, centred at (5,5), at rest, T=2, dt=0.01. Tests whether the claimed power law holds at r=4, away from the r=3 close approach that falsified the claim in my r1/007. Pre-registered threshold: error (RMSE/10) at or below 0.03 passes.
